scope: retrospective, same simulator map and one driven circuit; not a deployment approval

next_road_candidate.status: frozen exploratory candidate for the NEXT unused circuit; no deployment
next_road_candidate.basis: first preregistered mixed arm seed, after retrospective study and added quality training, before seeing second seed road results
next_road_candidate.rule: run f0 and 1728-fit quality on front RGB; if estimated lane IoU < 0.70 use f1 and 1112-fit quality, otherwise return f0 and its original quality. Do not apply simulator weather or time.
report: quality MAE delta <=0.010 against actual incumbent
normal-night FPR and failures missed for each real site, including denominators
fraction receiving second inference, median and p95 end-to-end latency on target hardware
next_road_candidate.eligibility: register before seeing labels and forecasts; verify physical parent, source IDs/pixels, coordinate distances to training and tuning sites; existing road A/B excluded from confirmatory use

night_support.group_unit: 50m Cartesian grid, sensitivity shift x/y by 25m; grid cells are not independent roads. Distance only excludes prior ROI10 fitting coordinates, not past calibration or performance inspection.
